messages:
mira: Heads-up: after yesterday's runtime bump to torch 2.3 + CUDA 12 we've started seeing intermittent OOMs on the 8k long-context runs. Profiling attached (short summary below). Anyone who touched allocator knobs?

mira: Quick summary: baseline (old knobs) 0.9% OOM rate, latest deploy ~7% OOM. Token throughput +-5%. Garbage_collection_threshold and expandable_segments both changed in the deploy. KV cache behave looks... spiky.

jamal: I touched expandable_segments briefly in the PR that landed the tok-batching improvement. I set expandable_segments=1 to allow more dynamic splits, and lowered max_split_size_mb from 64 -> 32 to attempt denser packing.

liam: Can you paste the small profiler snippet? also any traces of failed cudaMalloc in logs?

mira: log excerpt: ```
E CudaAlloc: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory, attempted 20971520 bytes
W Allocator: fallback to host staging buffer
I KVCache: evicted 2 entries due to fragmentation
```

mira: Perf capture: run A (old knobs): avg tokens/s=420, OOM=0.9% ; run B (new knobs): avg tokens/s=405, OOM=7.1% ; median latency same.

jamal: That pattern smells like fragmentation + too-small split causing many tiny heaps + more GC churn. expandable_segments=1 can increase split ops. Try: set expandable_segments=0 (disable), max_split_size_mb=48, garbage_collection_threshold=0.7. Also ensure workspace reuse flag is enabled in the runtime (we added a toggle in the last release).

liam: I'll run a quick A/B set on a small replica (8 workers) and report. Running two configs now:
- cfgA: expandable_segments=0, max_split_size_mb=48, gc_threshold=0.7
- cfgB: expandable_segments=1, max_split_size_mb=32, gc_threshold=0.5

alloc-bot: scheduled perf-job #prf-6734 with cfgA on cluster-qa-5. ETA ~12m.

sasha: FYI I have a patch that aims to reuse the attention workspace across sequence chunks instead of reallocing per step. It reduced alloc rate in local microbenchmarks ~35%. Diff snippet: ```diff
- alloc_workspace(seq_len)
+ reuse_or_alloc_workspace(seq_len, stream_id)
```

liam: cfgA completed: tokens/s=418, OOM=0.6% (2 OOMs out of 320 runs), fragmentation metrics down (peak free-block-count reduced). cfgB completed: tokens/s=403, OOM=8.8% (28/320).

mira: Good signal — reverting expandable_segments to 0 + bumping split size helped. Sasha, can you open a small PR for the workspace reuse and include a flag behind runtime-opts? We should gate it.

sasha: Yep will open PR with tests + a flag `runtime.enable_workspace_reuse`. I'll add a microbenchmark and a KV cache stress test to validate not regressing evictions.

jamal: Also propose adding an automated smoke check in the canary that runs the long-context profile (8k with deterministic seed) after allocator knob changes. Even a 1-run check would catch large OOM regressions.

mira: Agreed. Can someone add that to the deploy pipeline? If not today, at least to the next release branch.

alloc-bot: prf-6734 results uploaded to https://perf.internal/prf-6734 (artifacts + flamegraphs).

liam: One more note: gc_threshold changes trade off more frequent GC vs memory headroom. We should document recommended defaults for production: expandable_segments=0, max_split_size_mb=48-64, garbage_collection_threshold=0.65-0.75 for 16GB and above cards; lower cards may need more conservative split sizes.

mira: Adding that to runtime docs and will file a follow-up to update default knobs in the config map. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
